items: 【The Brain of Efficiency】Powered by the Core m3-8100Y multi-core processor, this 2-in-1 tablet handles everything from complex spreadsheets and dozens of browser tabs to seamless video calls without breaking a sweat. Experience instant responsiveness and smooth multitasking that keeps you ahead of your workflow.

【Ample Performance for Everything You Do】With the optimal combination of fast memory and speedy solid-state storage, the system boots in seconds, apps launch instantly, and file transfers are blazing quick. It's more than just 'enough' RAM—it's a guarantee of fluid, frustration-free performance for work and play.

【A Well-Balanced Hardware Ecosystem】Every component, is meticulously chosen and tuned to work in harmony. This isn't just a collection of specs; it's a refined, stable, and reliable platform designed for consistent, day-in, day-out performance you can count on.

【A Stunning High-Definition Display】Our high-resolution screen delivers vibrant colors, sharp details, and wide viewing angles. Whether you're editing photos, watching films, or reviewing documents for hours, it's easy on the eyes and a feast for them.

【Super Practical Array Of Ports】Designed for the real world, it comes loaded with the ports you actually use: USB-A, full-featured Type-C, Micro HDMI, and more. Connect your mouse, external drive, monitor, and projector simultaneously—no clunky adapters needed. True convenience, right out of the box.

【Your Outstanding Office Companion】This is the ultimate productivity partner. With a comfortable keyboard for long typing sessions, a precise touchpad, and rock-solid reliability for video conferencing and team collaboration, it’s built to help you create, present, and communicate with professional ease.

【Your Excellent Entertainment Buddy】After work, it transforms into your entertainment hub. Enjoy rich, detailed sound and a brilliant screen for streaming movies and music. With capable integrated graphics, it also handles casual gaming and creative hobbies beautifully. One device for all parts of your life.

【Big Battery & Advanced Cooling System】Freedom meets performance. The high-capacity battery delivers power for school, travel, or a coffee shop work session. Meanwhile, our intelligent cooling system with large heat dissipation areas ensures the laptop stays cool and quiet, even under load, maintaining peak performance.

【Professional 24/7 After-Sales Support】Your peace of mind is our priority. Backed by our professional global warranty and dedicated 24/7 customer support team, help is always just a call or click away. We ensure you get timely assistance and reliable service, wherever you are.
